sentences.en: They sent me a sample in answer to my request.
sentences.zh: 他们寄给我一个样品作为回应。

sentences.en: They took a sample of my blood at the hospital.
sentences.zh: 医院里他们采集了我的血液样本。

sentences.en: The test samples were due to arrive three days ago.
sentences.zh: 测试样品本应在三天前到达。

mnemonic: 联想记忆：简单的（simple）的样本（sample）
